name: Phase 09: does the explainer name the real cause of a big loss, using only the headlines it cites?

design.test_set: AAPL's 40 largest daily losses 2021-07-01..2023-12-31 with >=1 headline dated D-1 or D; candidates = union of fts and recent top 8; see docs/phase09-plan.md
design.baseline: quote: the cause is the text of the full-text-search top headline, no model
design.pass_rule: explainer 'matches = yes' rate above the quote's by a paired two-sided sign test p < 0.05, and at least 90% of the explainer's causes supported by their own citations

judge_check.scored_by: Claude (Opus 5.5), at the owner's request; see the third phase 09 deviation in docs/engineering-log.md

caveats: The reference labels were written by Claude (Opus 5.5), not a person: a logged deviation from the pre-registration, which said by hand.
The judge (Claude Sonnet 5.5) and the explainer (Claude Haiku 4.5) are Claude models too: the result shows these models agree with each other.
The judge check was scored by Claude as well, so its 90% agreement is not independent validation.
One run, 40 days of one stock (AAPL). Whether a person would agree with the labels is untested.
The retrieval comparison (full-text vs recency) was NOT significant by the pre-registered test.
No trading edge is claimed or implied: this grades explanations, not returns.
